title: Investment in Infrastructure to Support Social and Economic Development as Population Ages
what_it_is: Investment in Infrastructure to Support Social and Economic Development as Population Ages

sections.label: Action Plan for Successful Ageing
sections.summary: The 2015 Action Plan for Successful Ageing is a national blueprint, and the Government invests in continuing education and training for older workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Launched in 2015, the Action Plan for Successful Ageing outlines the national blueprint to help Singaporeans age well and age confidently, with strong family and community support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: First, to sustain our economic vitality and help Singaporeans adjust to the changing economy, the Government has been investing in continuing education and training (CET) infrastructure to help our older workers remain employable.

sections.label: WorkPro ageless workplaces support
sections.summary: The WorkPro scheme provides funding support for companies to redesign jobs for older workers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The Government also supports ageless workplaces through the WorkPro scheme which provides funding support for companies to redesign jobs for older workers.

sections.label: Housing, health and care for seniors
sections.summary: HDB offers 2-room Flexi flats and EASE, Active Ageing Hubs are set up, and hospital, nursing home and care places were added.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: HDB has provided more housing options for seniors, such as 2-room Flexi flats, and offered the Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE) programme to make the home environment safe for our seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We are also setting up "Active Ageing Hubs", which are one-stop day centres for seniors which provide active ageing services for seniors.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Since 2012, we have added 2,500 hospital beds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We also expanded our nursing home and community facilities, by adding 3,400 nursing home beds and 5,600 home and centre-based care places.

sections.label: Accessibility Fund for private buildings
sections.summary: A $40 million Accessibility Fund incentivises owners of existing private sector buildings to improve accessibility.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: A $40 million Accessibility Fund has been established to incentivise owners of existing private sector buildings to improve accessibility.
